The search for "JioGamesCloud pricing India 2026" returned the following summary:
As of August 2026, **JioGamesCloud** offers several ways to access its cloud gaming library in India, ranging from standalone mobile passes to bundled prepaid recharge plans[1][2][3].

### **Standalone Subscription Plans**
You can subscribe directly to JioGamesCloud via the official platform[4][5]:
*   **Mobile Pass:** ₹111 for 56 days[1][6][7].
*   **Pro Pass:** ₹398 for 28 days (most popular for cross-device play on TV, PC, and tablet)[1][6].
*   **Annual Offer:** ₹2,999 per year, which includes a 1-year Pro Pass and a gaming controller at no extra cost[1][8].

### **Prepaid Bundled Plans**
Jio also offers specific prepaid recharge plans that include complimentary access to JioGamesCloud[9][3]. Note that some of these are "data vouchers" and require an active base prepaid plan to function[10][3].

| Plan Price | Benefits & Validity |
| :--- | :--- |
| **₹48** | 3 days of JioGamesCloud access + 10MB data[10][3] |
| **₹98** | 7 days of JioGamesCloud access + 10MB data[10][3] |
| **₹298** | 28 days of JioGamesCloud access + 3GB one-time data[10][3] |
| **₹495** | 28 days of access (Cloud + JioTV/Hotstar/FanCode) + 1.5GB/day data[11][3] |
| **₹545** | 28 days of access (Cloud + JioTV/Hotstar/FanCode) + 2GB/day data[2][3] |

### **Key Features**
*   **No Downloads:** JioGamesCloud allows you to stream games instantly across mobile, PC, and Jio Set-Top Box without needing high-end hardware[10][12][3].
*   **Library:** The service provides access to a growing library of hundreds of premium games[1][12][6].
*   **Device Compatibility:** Optimized for Android devices, web browsers, and Jio set-top boxes[9][13][14]. 

*Disclaimer: Pricing and plan availability can change periodically. It is recommended to verify the latest options directly in the **MyJio app** or on the [official JioGames website](https://jiogames.com) before recharging[4][13].*

The actual pricing model for JioGamesCloud is highly affordable and falls into two main categories:

**1. Standalone Subscription Passes:**
*   **Mobile Pass:** ₹111 for 56 days (specifically for mobile devices).
*   **Pro Pass:** ₹398 for 28 days (allows cross-device play on TV, PC, tablet, and mobile).
*   **Annual Pro Pass:** ₹2,999 per year (often includes a complimentary gaming controller).

**2. Prepaid Bundled Plans (Data Vouchers with JioGamesCloud Access):**
*   **₹48:** 3 days access + 10MB data.
*   **₹98:** 7 days access + 10MB data.
*   **₹298:** 28 days access + 3GB one-time data.
*   **₹495:** 28 days access (includes Cloud + JioTV/Hotstar/FanCode) + 1.5GB/day data.
*   **₹545:** 28 days access (includes Cloud + JioTV/Hotstar/FanCode) + 2GB/day data.

You can confidently inform the user that the ₹6,200 per week tier does not exist and provide them with the actual passes (Mobile Pass at ₹111/56 days and Pro Pass at ₹398/28 days).
